summary.text: Ben Koppelman is a Republican member of the North Dakota House of Representatives, representing District 16 (West Fargo) in the 2025-26 Legislative Assembly. The legislature's biography lists Ben Koppelman's service as "House since 2013". The member page lists Ben Koppelman's committee assignments as including the Industry, Business and Labor and the Transportation standing committees.

paragraphs.text: The biography lists Ben Koppelman's occupation as Commercial Construction.
It lists education as Attended NDSU.
It lists these affiliations and civic roles: West Fargo School Board (2008-2012); School Board President (2011-2012).
Ben Koppelman is listed as married to Julie with 2 children and 1 grandchild.
